meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会为你的多个 git 工作树/分支/PR 组织一场只读“群聊”，每个分支由一名代理发言，互相比较改动、协商冲突，最后产出一份整合计划（目标工作树、合并顺序、冲突处理），并给你一段人话摘要。
howto.when: 当你想比较并整合多个工作树、分支或 PR 的改动时，可让 Claude 开启 standup。触发方式包括按时间筛选最近活动的分支（如 1h/24h），或手动点名分支/PR。

say.text: 按最近24小时的活动分支开个standup，给我整合计划。
say.note: Claude会筛选分支并组织群聊。

say.text: 比较一下 feature-x 和 PR #12，给出合并方案。
say.note: Claude会定向邀请这两个代理协商。

say.text: 把当前所有工作树做个standup，说下怎么合并。
say.note: Claude会让每个分支自我介绍并协调。

howto.what_en: Claude hosts a read-only standup chat across git worktrees/branches/PRs. Each branch is an agent; they compare changes, resolve conflicts, and produce a consolidation plan (target worktree, merge order, resolutions) plus a human-readable summary.
howto.when_en: When you want to compare and consolidate changes across multiple worktrees, branches, or PRs. Trigger by asking for a standup, filtering by recent activity windows (e.g., 1h/24h) or naming specific branches/PRs.

say_en.text: Run a standup for branches active in the last 24h and give me a plan.
say_en.note: Claude will pick branches and host the chat.

say_en.text: Compare feature-x and PR #12; propose a merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude will invite those two agents to settle.

say_en.text: Run a standup across all current worktrees and tell me how to merge.
say_en.note: Claude will have each branch introduce itself and reconcile.
